description: IT-95 / US-07 AC3. Every card here carries annotations of unknown purpose beside recognised survey content; what counts as noise is D020 (docs/decisions/D020-noise-vs-meaningful-annotations.md), cited per mark below. `expected` records the meaningful values a reader must still surface -- deliberately the fields nearest each noise mark, plus every field inside the r02 oval, not the whole card. Transcribed by Qitao against the scan, 2026-09-17. Excluded from `expected`: every field IT-93's manifest and D020 class as struck (FR-06), corrected (D020 'Related, not FR-06 -- a correction': r02 Retired and Indep. Persons, r02 Other, r04 Industry of H.) or unclassified (r01 Number of Living Rooms). Their expected value belongs to IT-93, not here.
